主要内容: On July 28, 2015, Medallion Financial Corp authorized management to repurchase up to $26,000,000 of its common stock. From September 11, 2015, through September 16, 2015, the company purchased 243,397 shares at $6.58 per share, totaling $1,601,885. As of September 16, 2015, $16,908,349 remained available for future repurchases. Additionally, since the inception of its original stock repurchase program in November 2003, a total of 2,569,951 shares were repurchased at a cost of $23,063,624, for an average cost of $8.97 per share. The repurchase program reflects the company's commitment to returning value to shareholders.
